What actually moves

The browser deforms separate regions of one original illustration. These are independent mesh controls, not separate painted layers or a complete skeletal character.

Head
A depth-shaped face rotates through a limited angle, blending into an anchored neck. It cannot reveal unseen anatomy.
Eyes and eyelids
Iris vertices follow your input faster than the head. Eyelid vertices close and reopen on a timed blink. Clean cinematic eyelids still need painted lid and eyeball layers.
Breathing
Chest and shoulder vertices expand and rise subtly over a 5.8-second cycle. The head and image boundary stay fixed when only breathing is enabled.
Existing website
The character performances and Mothership footage remain MP4 playback. The landing page and its satellites are unchanged.
Next production step
Consistent head angles, concealed neck and shoulder artwork, separate eyes and eyelids, or a sculpted 3D head with facial controls. Arms, fabric and cinematic actions need their own rig.

[ Renderer preparing ]

Show rig reveals the actual triangles: head, eyes, eyelids and breathing areas are highlighted. Reduced motion starts paused. Motion stops when the portrait is offscreen or the tab is hidden.
